# Behaviour gaps

<!-- Generated by `memors-scenario book` from `internal/eval/testdata/scenario-catalogue.yaml`. Do not edit: change the source and run `make scenario-docs`. -->

Reading the code with scenarios in mind surfaced behaviours that no test pinned down. Some are bugs, some are decisions never taken. Each becomes a scenario tagged `decision: open` that asserts today's behaviour; the owner then decides per gap to keep it, change it, or document it only. A fix is a separate change whose scenario is shown failing first and then flips to `decided` (see [Open and decided](decisions.md)).

<a id="gap-1"></a>

## Gap 1: A tool-channel revision of a curated source stays curated

`Ingest` updates hash, etag, fetched_at and title on an existing source and never checks the channel cap; forget and supersede are guarded, revise is not.

- **Where:** `kb/store.go` `Ingest`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [B6 Promote, then an agent revises](catalogue.md#b6)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-2"></a>

## Gap 2: A fact whose evidence document is forgotten stays live with no evidence

`evidence_chunk_id ON DELETE SET NULL` and `Forget` deletes chunks; no audit row, no lint kind, and `verify` cannot see it.

- **Where:** `kb/schema_v1.go`, `kb/facts.go` `Forget`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [D2 Revoked but still reachable](catalogue.md#d2)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-3"></a>

## Gap 3: Pages built from forgotten or revised sources are still served

Such pages are served at `granularity: page` with the old content, flagged `stale` only.

- **Where:** `kb/facts.go`, `retrieve/pages.go`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [D2 Revoked but still reachable](catalogue.md#d2)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-4"></a>

## Gap 4: submit writes page_sources from the payload captured at compact time

Passages added or revised between `compact` and `submit` are missing, and cited chunk ids may be gone.

- **Where:** `compact/submit.go`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [C7 Submit after concurrent ingest](catalogue.md#c7)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-5"></a>

## Gap 5: Re-ingesting an older cached copy creates a new revision with old content

Dedup compares only the current revision's hash, so an old copy becomes revision N+1.

- **Where:** `kb/store.go` `Ingest`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [C4 Stale re-ingest](catalogue.md#c4)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-6"></a>

## Gap 6: The actor name is the self-declared ClientInfo.Name

The actor in audit, the call log and the live page is the client's own name; two clients with one name are indistinguishable.

- **Where:** `server/server.go` `clientName`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [C3 Spoofed actor](catalogue.md#c3)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-7"></a>

## Gap 7: The elicitation request state is unsigned

The state is plain text; a client that advertises the capability can answer its own question and raise trust on the `elicitation` channel (spike S7; an HTTP server would need to sign it).

- **Where:** `server/server.go` `promoteState`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [B8 Elicitation on HTTP with several clients](catalogue.md#b8)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-8"></a>

## Gap 8: A fact past valid_to is served by default

`as_of` filters on recorded time only, and only `lint` notices an expired fact.

- **Where:** `retrieve/retrieve.go`, `compact/lint.go`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [A1 Expiry during the run](catalogue.md#a1)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-9"></a>

## Gap 9: A tombstone's reason is served verbatim

A tool-channel forget can plant instruction-shaped text in the reason.

- **Where:** `kb/read.go`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [D5 Instruction text in reasons and titles](catalogue.md#d5)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-10"></a>

## Gap 10: Paraphrased agreements become conflict items

Two facts about one subject are a conflict unless their statements are identical after key normalisation, so agents agreeing in different words produce one conflict item per pair.

- **Where:** `compact/compact.go` `Conflicts`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [C1 Same claim, different words](catalogue.md#c1)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-11"></a>

## Gap 11: A skipped work item is re-created on the next compact

`UpsertWorkItem` matches `state = 'open'` only, so a skipped item comes back with no new evidence.

- **Where:** `kb/pages.go`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [B5 Partial review](catalogue.md#b5)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-12"></a>

## Gap 12: The graph cache rebuilds on mention count only

A revision with the same live mention count serves stale chunk ids to the graph arm.

- **Where:** `retrieve/arm_graph.go` `graphFor`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [E8 Graph cache same-count revision](catalogue.md#e8)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-13"></a>

## Gap 13: A crash between the ingest commit and vector storage leaves no job

Jobs are enqueued only when the embedder is absent or fails; chunks are left with no vectors and only `verify --repair` recovers them.

- **Where:** `kb/store.go` `Ingest`, `embedChunks`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [E1 Crash between commit and vectors](catalogue.md#e1)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-14"></a>

## Gap 14: `export --md` omits facts

`export --md` writes documents and pages, not facts; "re-import yields nothing new" is proven for documents only.

- **Where:** `kb/export.go`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [E5 Export/import at mid-life](catalogue.md#e5)
- **Pinned by:** no scenario yet

<a id="gap-15"></a>

## Gap 15: A forgotten fact re-recorded with the same statement is unlinked

The new fact is a fresh fact; nothing links it to the forget reason.

- **Where:** `kb/facts.go` `Remember`
- **Decision:** open
- **Catalogue:** [B2 Zombie fact](catalogue.md#b2)
